Diagnosis:
CAUSE: Pod `catalog-6b8cf764b7-gd99z` in namespace `shop` is stuck in ImagePullBackOff because its container `catalog` references the image tag `docker.io/library/nginx:1.99`, which does not exist in the registry.

EVIDENCE:
- `kubectl --context kind-sre-lab describe -n shop pod catalog-6b8cf764b7-gd99z` (checked by me): container `catalog` has `Image: docker.io/library/nginx:1.99`, State `Waiting`, Reason `ImagePullBackOff`, `Ready: False`, Restart Count 0.
- Same describe, Events: `Warning Failed ... Failed to pull image "docker.io/library/nginx:1.99": ... docker.io/library/nginx:1.99: not found`, then `Error: ErrImagePull` and `Error: ImagePullBackOff` (x7 over 2m4s).
- Same describe, Events: `Normal BackOff ... Back-off pulling image "docker.io/library/nginx:1.99"`, confirming the kubelet is retrying the same bad tag.
- diag-k8s reported (`kubectl --context kind-sre-lab get -n shop deployment catalog -o jsonpath={.spec.template.spec.containers[0].image}`): the Deployment template returns `docker.io/library/nginx:1.99`, so the bad tag comes from the Deployment, not from the pod. I did not re-check this read myself.

FIX (not applied): Change the image of the `catalog` container in the `catalog` Deployment in namespace `shop` to an existing tag (for example `docker.io/library/nginx:1.27-alpine`) so the new ReplicaSet can pull and start.

Fact.Name: cause
Fact.Value: the tag `1.99` does not exist in the registry (`not found`), not a credentials problem
